messages.author: 9125e89fd92dd317
messages.subject: Graphs produced with specific values?
parts:
Hi All,

I am wondering if ggplot2 can produce graphs based on specific predicted values from a multivariate regression where one could enter the specific coordinate points to be plotted and then add a linear line connecting the points for each group (similar to the attached graph)? If so, examples or pointing me in the right direction is appreciated.

Thank you,

AC

#code below

data <- data.frame(risk=c("normal", "at-risk", "compl"),
                   (-1)*pred.dels[,-1])

data
     risk    Del8_50   Del10_50    Del12_50     Del8_80    Del10_80   Del12_80
1  normal -0.1770983 -0.3123516 -0.44760478 -0.46899793 -0.60425116 -0.7395044
2 at-risk  0.3375657  0.2023125  0.06705926  0.04566611 -0.08958712 -0.2248403
3   compl -0.2925174 -0.4277707 -0.56302389 -0.58441705 -0.71967027 -0.8549235

 par(mfrow=c(1,2))
 plot(c(8,10,12),t(data[1,2:4]), xlab="Sessions", xlim=c(8,12),
     ylim=c(min(data[,-1]), max(data[,-1])),
     ylab="Effect size (del)", type="n", axes=TRUE,
     main="F:M = 1:1")
 matlines(c(8,10,12), t(data[1,2:4]), type="b",
         lty=1, pch=19, col="blue")
 matlines(c(8,10,12), t(data[2,2:4]), type="b",
         lty=2, pch=20, col="red")
 matlines(c(8,10,12), t(data[3,2:4]), type="b",
         lty=3, pch=21, col="brown")
 
 plot(c(8,10,12),t(data[1,5:7]), xlab="Sessions", xlim=c(8,12),
     ylim=c(min(data[,-1]), max(data[,-1])),
     ylab="Effect size (del)", type="n", axes=TRUE,
     main="F:M = 4:1")
 matlines(c(8,10,12), t(data[1,5:7]), type="b",
         lty=1, pch=19, col="blue")
 matlines(c(8,10,12), t(data[2,5:7]), type="b",
         lty=2, pch=20, col="red")
 matlines(c(8,10,12), t(data[3,5:7]), type="b",
         lty=3, pch=21, col="brown")

Hi AC, I had to reshape your data a bit
data<-read.csv(file="C:/Documents and Settings/cedric/Bureau/Classeur1.csv",sep=";")
# I've reloaded your data frame but without the first column
#Del8_50   Del10_50    Del12_50     Del8_80    Del10_80   Del12_80
#1       -0.1770983 -0.3123516 -0.44760478 -0.46899793 -0.60425116 -0.7395044
#2        0.3375657  0.2023125  0.06705926  0.04566611 -0.08958712 -0.2248403
#3       -0.2925174 -0.4277707 -0.56302389 -0.58441705 -0.71967027 -0.8549235
data["session",]=rep(c(8,10,12),2)
data["group",]=c(rep("F:M=1:1",3),rep("F:M=4:1",3))
data1=as.data.frame(t(data))
colnames(data1)<-c("normal","at_risk","compl","sessions","groups")
data1<-melt(data1, id.vars=c(4,5), measure.vars=c(1:3), variable_name = "variable")
# some variables in data1 are now factors :
data1$value=as.numeric(as.character(data1$value))
data1$sessions=as.numeric(as.character(data1$sessions))

#sessions  groups variable       value
#1         8 F:M=1:1   normal -0.17709830
#2        10 F:M=1:1   normal -0.31235160
#3        12 F:M=1:1   normal -0.44760478
#4         8 F:M=4:1   normal -0.46899793
#5        10 F:M=4:1   normal -0.60425116
#6        12 F:M=4:1   normal -0.73950440
#7         8 F:M=1:1  at_risk  0.33756570
#8        10 F:M=1:1  at_risk  0.20231250
#9        12 F:M=1:1  at_risk  0.06705926
#10        8 F:M=4:1  at_risk  0.04566611
#11       10 F:M=4:1  at_risk -0.08958712
#12       12 F:M=4:1  at_risk -0.22484030
#13        8 F:M=1:1    compl -0.29251740
#14       10 F:M=1:1    compl -0.42777070
#15       12 F:M=1:1    compl -0.56302389
#16        8 F:M=4:1    compl -0.58441705
#17       10 F:M=4:1    compl -0.71967027
#18       12 F:M=4:1    compl -0.85492350


ggplot(data1)+geom_point(aes(x=sessions,y=value,col=variable))+geom_line(aes(x=sessions,y=value,group=variable,linetype=variable))+
facet_grid(facets=. ~ groups)+scale_y_continuous(name="Effect size del")+scale_colour_manual(values = c("blue","red", "green"))

I have joined the picture.

Cédric

> #9        12 F:M=1:1  at_risk  0.06705926

> #12       12 F:M=4:1  at_risk -0.22484030

> #16        8 F:M=4:1    compl -0.58441705
> #17       10 F:M=4:1    compl -0.71967027
> #18       12 F:M=4:1    compl -0.85492350
>
>
> ggplot(data1)+geom_point(aes(x=sessions,y=value,col=variable))+geom_line(aes(x=sessions,y=value,group=variable,linetype=variable))+
> facet_grid(facets=. ~ groups)+scale_y_continuous(name="Effect size
> del")+scale_colour_manual(values = c("blue","red", "green"))

Or slightly more idiomatic:

ggplot(data1, aes(sessions, value)) +
geom_line(aes(linetype = variable)) +
geom_point(aes(colour = variable)) +
facet_grid(facets=. ~ groups) +
scale_y_continuous("Effect size del") +
scale_colour_brewer("Subgroup", pal = "Set1")

(plus I swapped the order of points and lines so points are on top)

Hadley

parts:
Beautiful! Thank you kindly, Cedric and Hadley.

Here is a slightly modified version that is close to what we'll eventually use: 

ggplot(data1, aes(Sessions, value)) +
 geom_line(aes(linetype = Group)) +
 geom_point(aes(shape=Group,color = Group)) +
 facet_grid(facets=. ~ Female) +
 scale_y_continuous("Effect Size (del)") +
 scale_colour_brewer("Group", pal = "Set1")

Thanks again,

AC
